title: A 10pm lead still needs an email

slides.alt: Real estate agents A 10pm lead still needs an email. The text can wait until morning.
Email: 1. The email goes out right away It names the property and asks which day works to see it.
Text: 2. Text only with the lead’s consent And only from 8am to 9pm in their own time.
Text: 3. At 10pm the text waits It goes out at 8:00 the next morning.
Text: 4. Reply STOP A text that is still waiting gets cancelled.
Backup: 5. The backup agent still gets a 10pm ping If your team does not want night pings, that rule has to be added.
When a buyer writes after dinner What goes out tonight, and what waits until morning? Email now. The text can wait.
